Zero Claude generation calls were made, zero publishes/broadcasts triggered, zero signature emails sent, and the founder Reference Library approve button was not touched. 7/7 backend pytest passed in /app/backend/tests/test_modules_1_to_6_refactor.py. Only one TEST external applicant was created ('TEST_ExternalCandidate_Modules' via backend test + 'TEST External Candidate' via UI); neither could be fully deleted (no DELETE endpoint on /api/workspace/applications/{id}, returned 405 — noted as minor).

minor.issue: Not implemented (returned 405). Prevents clean teardown of TEST external applicants created during testing. Owner UI does not surface a delete either — consider adding for QA-friendliness and for founders who want to remove test/spam applicants.

action_items: Optional: add DELETE /api/workspace/applications/{id} (owner-scoped) so QA + founders can remove test/spam applicants — one TEST external applicant is left in the owner-review-admin tenant from this run.

Optional cleanup: delete the two TEST applicants from db.opportunity_applications where owner_user_id='owner-review-admin' and profile_snapshot.full_name starts with 'TEST' (created during this iteration).
critical_code_review_comments: workspace_routes.add_external_applicant still accepts email/phone/linkedin/notes as Form fields even though the new UI never sends them. Harmless (all default to ''), but if the intent is strict name-only, tighten the endpoint to reject non-empty email/phone/linkedin so a stale front-end never silently persists PII the founder no longer intended to collect.

Module3 ApplicationPanel silently ignores /workspace/opportunity/application/generate failures beyond a generic error string. Consider surfacing the backend detail (e.g., 401/403) more prominently since this endpoint has no confirmation step.

opportunity_readiness treats application_saved as bool(custom_questions is not None AND opportunity.application_saved). The custom_questions check is now vestigial — the new endpoint always sets custom_questions=[]. Fine today but a future 'skip application' path could regress the readiness check unexpectedly.

ai_service.GENERATION_TYPES 'personal_invitation_email' has no conditional-visibility flag on the backend; the front-end alone decides whether to render the card based on Module 2 intake. If a future customer manually visits /api/workspace/generate with type=personal_invitation_email without answering the intake, generation will succeed with no upstream guard.
